answer.reason: Beyond its inheritance by Manasseh, the verses tell chiefly of Israel's conquest of Bashan from King Og.

clauses.english: had all its cities taken by Israel when King Og and his people were destroyed
clauses.quote: we took all his cities at that time

doubts: Left out the bulls, oaks, kine and fatlings of Bashan (PSA 22:12, ISA 2:13, AMO 4:1, EZK 39:18 and others) as figures of speech, not events.
Left out Dan leaping from Bashan (DEU 33:22) as a blessing pronounced, not an event.
Left out the lists of Levitical cities and cities of refuge, such as Golan, as lists that name places inside Bashan.
Left out the allotment of Bashan to Manasseh, since the summary already says it.
